+description: |
+  The AI Foundry ET-SoC-1 extensions are the custom RISC-V instruction set extensions
+  originally designed by Esperanto Technologies for the ET-SoC-1 manycore AI accelerator chip,
+  now open-sourced under the AI Foundry umbrella.
+
+  The ET-SoC-1 contains 1,088 in-order ET-Minion cores (RV64IMFC + custom extensions),
+  four out-of-order ET-Maxion cores, and one Service Processor core.
+
+  Each ET-Minion core includes an 8-lane SIMD vector/tensor processing unit (VPU) that
+  extends the floating-point registers from 32 bits to 256 bits (8 x 32-bit lanes), and adds
+  8 mask registers (m0-m7) of 8 bits each.
+
+  The custom extensions are organized into the following sub-extensions:
+
+  * *Xaifoundryps* -- Packed Single (PS) instructions for 8xFP32 SIMD operations
+  * *Xaifoundrypi* -- Packed Integer (PI) instructions for 8xINT32 SIMD operations
+  * *Xaifoundrymask* -- Mask register operations (m0-m7)

+  * *Xaifoundryfcc* -- Fast Credit Counter synchronization
+  * *Xaifoundryipi* -- Inter-Processor Interrupt facility

+  deviations:

+  * No hardware division or square root -- these instructions trap to M-mode

+  * Input denormals are flushed to zero in hardware.

+description: |
+  The Cache Control extension provides instructions and CSRs for managing the ET-Minion's
+  data cache hierarchy.
+
+  Each ET-Minion core has a 4 KB L1 data cache (16-set, 4-way, 64-byte lines) that can
+  be configured as:
+
+  * Shared mode (C0): dynamically shared between the two hardware threads
+  * Split mode (C1): hard-partitioned, each thread gets 2 KB
+  * Scratchpad mode (C2): 1 KB cache + 3 KB scratchpad (only in split mode)
+
+  Cache configuration is controlled via the `mcache_control` (M-mode) and `ucache_control`
+  (U-mode, restricted view) CSRs.
+
+  Cache control operations are encoded as CSR writes and include:
+
+  * Flush: write back dirty lines to next cache level
+  * Invalidate: discard cache lines without writeback
+  * FlushInvalidate: write back then invalidate
+  * Lock: lock cache lines to prevent eviction
+  * Prefetch: bring data into cache from memory
+
+  These operations can target L1, L2, L3, or memory levels.

+description: |
+  The Packed Single (PS) extension adds SIMD instructions that operate on 8 x FP32 values
+  packed within 256-bit floating-point registers.
+
+  The extension widens the RISC-V floating-point registers from 32 bits (FLEN=32 for RV64F)
+  to 256 bits (FLEN=256), so each FP register holds 8 elements of 32 bits each (e0 through e7).
+
+  All PS instructions execute under the control of the m0 mask register. When a bit in m0
+  is clear, the corresponding lane's result is zero.
+
+  Scalar floating-point operations (RV64F) operate on the low 32 bits (e0) and set
+  bits 255:32 to zero.
+
+  The PS extension includes:
+
+  * Load/Store: FLQ2, FSQ2, FLW.PS, FSW.PS
+  * Broadcast: FBC.PS, FBCX.PS, FBCI.PS
+  * Gather/Scatter: FGW.PS, FGH.PS, FGB.PS, FSCW.PS, FSCH.PS, FSCB.PS
+  * Restricted Gather/Scatter: FG32W.PS, FG32H.PS, FG32B.PS, FSC32W.PS, FSC32H.PS, FSC32B.PS
+  * Arithmetic: FADD.PS, FSUB.PS, FMUL.PS, FDIV.PS, FMIN.PS, FMAX.PS, FSQRT.PS
+  * FMA: FMADD.PS, FMSUB.PS, FNMADD.PS, FNMSUB.PS
+  * Conditional: FCMOV.PS, FCMOVM.PS
+  * Convert: FCVT.PW.PS, FCVT.PWU.PS, FCVT.PS.PW, FCVT.PS.PWU, and many more format conversions
+  * Sign manipulation: FSGNJ.PS, FSGNJN.PS, FSGNJX.PS
+  * Move: FMVZ.X.PS, FMVS.X.PS
+  * Compare: FEQ.PS, FLE.PS, FLT.PS, FEQM.PS, FLEM.PS, FLTM.PS, FCLASS.PS
+  * Transcendental: FSIN.PS, FEXP.PS, FLOG.PS, FRCP.PS, FRSQ.PS

+description: |
+  The Tensor extension adds matrix multiply and related tensor operations to the ET-Minion
+  core's Vector Processing Unit (VPU).
+
+  Tensor operations are multi-cycle state-machine operations that perform matrix
+  computations using the VPU's 8 lanes. Matrices are stored in the L1 scratchpad
+  (A matrix in row-major, B matrix in column-major) and results accumulate in
+  FP registers.
+
+  The extension provides:
+
+  * *Tensor Load*: Load data from memory to L1 scratchpad, with support for
+    interleaving (8/16-bit) and transposition (8/16/32-bit).
+  * *Tensor Load L2 SCP*: Load data into the L2 scratchpad.
+  * *Tensor FMA16A32*: FP16 matrix multiply accumulating into FP32.
+  * *Tensor IMA8A32*: INT8 matrix multiply accumulating into INT32.
+  * *Tensor FMA32*: FP32 matrix multiply accumulating into FP32.
+  * *Tensor Quant*: Matrix A transformations (quantization).
+  * *Tensor Store*: Store matrix A from scratchpad to memory.
+  * *Tensor Store from SCP*: Store data directly from L1 scratchpad.
+  * *Tensor Send/Recv*: Transfer values between FP registers and the tensor unit.
+  * *Tensor Reduce*: Reduction operations on FP register values.
+  * *Tensor Broadcast*: Broadcast from FP registers to tensor unit.
+  * *Tensor Wait*: Wait for tensor operations to complete.
+
+  The extension also defines several CSRs:
+
+  * `tensor_mask` (0x805): Mask for tensor operations
+  * `tensor_conv_size` (0x802): Convolution size parameters
+  * `tensor_conv_ctrl` (0x803): Convolution control
+  * `tensor_coop` (0x804): Cooperative tensor load control
+  * `tensor_error` (0x808): Error status for tensor operations
